integrity: The proof is self-contained. Two standalone finite verification programs corroborate the maximum counts and pivot components but do not establish the infinite statement by computation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to incident-edge replacement of maximum induced matchings in squared cycles of order at least five; it does not concern arbitrary edge jumps, token sliding on the conflict graph, or exact diameters. Historical originality is subject to unavailable or unindexed literature; no independent scholarly audit has been completed.
title: Induced-matching edge-pivot mobility in squared cycles
